articles.title: Coming Home Walkthrough - GTA 6 Guide - IGN
articles.summary: In the Coming Home main mission in Grand Theft Auto VI, Lucia was approved for early home release, and it’s time to pick her up. This official IGN GTA 6
articles.body:
In the Coming Home main mission in Grand Theft Auto VI , Lucia was approved for early home release, and it’s time to pick her up. This official IGN GTA 6 guide walks you through how to complete the Chapter 1 mission, Coming Home.

Click on a link below to jump to that specific section of this guide:

This mission is available after Lucia calls Jason from the penitentiary. If you don’t want to wait until the next day for her to call, you can go to bed and sleep to pass the time. As soon as Jason wakes up in the morning, Lucia calls and asks Jason to pick her up. When you’re ready, hop in the truck (with her change of clothes in the trunk, if you picked them up from Andy) and head to north Hamlet to get Lucia. Approaching the prison kicks off the mission.

When you’re .12 mi from the prison, a short scene featuring Jason’s approach begins and the mission truly kicks off. Exit the vehicle and walk toward reception. When you’re close, Jason leans in and asks security for Lucia, starting a cutscene from four months ago.

The cutscene features a call between Jason and Lucia, and Lucia sharing the news about Tomas with Jason for the first time, and ends with Lucia and Jason reuniting at the prison exit.

Return to your car with a very excited Lucia. Depending on what optional missions you accomplished leading up to picking up Lucia, she’ll comment on changes or improvements. For instance, if you’re wearing something rather casual, she’ll note it. Any optional tasks you did complete contribute points toward building your relationship.

Instead of heading home, you’re heading to a party. Drive south back to Key Lento toward the north side of the island, following the GPS to The Rusty Anchor bar. During the drive, Jason asks if Lucia’s aunt can bring down their son for a visit, but Lucia explains that given the situation, it’s currently not possible. They’ve just got to keep their head down and prepare for the future. Lucia suggests that a new friend she made in prison, Kat, might have a lead for them on more lucrative work. Pull into the marked parking spot at The Rust Anchor then head on in to continue.

If you brought Lucia the change of clothes from Andy, she’ll grab the bag and head into the bar with it. Head to the bar while she’s in the bathroom to meet up with Cal who orders three beers. Jason’s crew rolls in and awkward introductions ensue. Lucia goes out back to escape Donnie and Cal and asks for you to grab her another beer. Your next main objective is to speak with the bartender and order her a Pindayho - and another for Jason if you’d like. You can speak with other folks in the bar as you walk back to Lucia.

Delivering the beer kicks off another cutscene where the two spend time catching up. Toward the end, Lucia announces that her rich friend Kat and her husband are on their way, to Jason’s dismay.

The cutscene ends with Jason in the bathroom. I highly recommend using the sink to wash Jason’s hands afterward, not only because it’s sanitary, but also because using the sink gives Jason a Focus buff . Keep an eye out for quick ways to buff stats like this throughout Leonida. It can help in a pinch.

Back at the bar, Cal and Lucia order more drinks and chat. Not long after, Lori and Brian arrive. From here, you can steal Lucia away from Lori (for a small relationship boost) or watch and listen to the other conversations. Lucia gets a call either way and steps out.

This next part is far more casual and there are plenty of folks you can talk to throughout the bar. You’re only required to speak with Cal and Donnie to progress, but if you’d like, walk around and speak with other patrons to learn more about them and get some unique interactions.

Speak with Cal – When you talk with Cal, you can choose to help him swipe through matches on his dating app.

Speak with Donnie – On the other side of the bar, Donnie asks if you want to go out for some coke. You can choose either way. If you choose to, you’ll miss some optional interactions around the bar and it’ll have a negative effect on Jason’s relationship with Lucia.

You can check in on Lucia early to listen in on her call, or you can wait until you get the objective to meet up with her after speaking with Cal and Donnie. She’ll text you. This leads to the “Aviators” walking up and bothering Lucia. You can interrupt (points toward building the relations) or let her handle it (no change). Whatever you do, you don’t have long to decide. Just after, Lucia’s friends Kat and Mattia show up at the bar with not much good to say about The Rusty Anchor. Mattia immediately shows off by spending money, kicking off the party to new heights. Lucia invites Jason to dance, prompting another chance to build the relationship. If you choose to, dance with Lucia by holding L2 + R2 / LT + RT . When prompted, add “flair” to your moves by pressing Square / X .

Not long into the song, Kat and Mattia talk next to Jason and Lucia, before Kat steps back as her baby moves, giving you more interaction options. Another cutscene kicks off with Andy’s arrival. Andy and Lucia’s joyful reunion varies based on whether you met up with her before picking up Lucia. If you want, you can try to improve Jason’s relationship with Andy by speaking to hear at the bar after Lucia walks off to find Kat, or you can try to find Mattia like Lucia asked.

You’ll find Mattia out back on the phone and he won’t want to talk, so it’s best to find him later.

You’ve got another chance to walk around the bar, engage in activities like drinking or dancing, and of course, talk with Jason’s friends. A few are specifically pointed out as objectives:

Donnie – Once again, he’s down for more cocaine. If you accept, time passes again, but again, this will negatively affect Jason’s relationship with Lucia.

Rhonda – Speaking to Rhonda offers an opportunity to dance with her, then help with an important task that’ll improve Jason’s professionalism rating if completed.

Brian – You won’t get an explicit chat option with the very drunk Brian, but you can stand next to him and hear him mumble about kids. You can also listen to him chat with Mattia once he sits down in the next seat.

Andy – She has a short anecdote to share about Lucia when she was young.

To progress, talk to Mattia at the bar or accept Donnie’s offer. If you speak with Mattia like Lucia asked, you’ll start a short cutscene between the two men. Jason starts asking about work, but Mattia shrugs him off. The scene ends with Mattia asking Jason to play pool.

You’ll find pool tables in bars and clubs all around Leonida. This first encounter serves as a brief introduction to playing. Grab a pool cue from the wall next to the pool table with L1 / LB , then approach the end of the table with the white ball to begin.

You can add an optional spin to your shot by pressing and holding Triangle / Y while making your shot.

Use the right thumbstick ( Right Stick ) to adjust your angle.

When you’re ready to shoot, use the left thumbstick ( Left Stick ) or R2 / RT to pull back the pool cue. The amount you move or press the thumbstick or R2 / RT impacts the force of your shot.

Push forward on Left Stick or release R2 / RT to make your shot.

The first pocketed ball determines whether you play as stripes or solids. The assigned type is the kind you want to pocket. When it’s your turn again, you’re placed in front of the white ball you’ll use to shoot. If you’d like, you can move left and right to adjust the starting angle, then repeat the shooting steps to make your move. A preview of the outcome of the expected move shows with transparent white path lines that extend a few inches from the ball, allowing you to estimate what your move will do and adjust as needed. After you take your second turn, the Aviators who were previously hogging the pool table return and hassle Lucia and Kat about their boys taking the table. Continue playing as the Aviators watch and annoy the group. After a bit of time, one of the guys, D-Man, picks up the white ball and interrupts the game. The cutscene kicks off. Mattia and Kat leave while Jason goes out front with D-Man for a fight.

This is a very quick brawl. After knocking out D-Man, two other men step forward to fight. Give them each a few punches, and as you do, Lucia joins in and chokes out the Aviator standing next to her before he can join the fray.

When all men are down, police cars come rolling in, prompting Lucia to excitedly run off, inviting Jason to follow. Run her way and follow her through the neighborhoods. Jason suggests running to the water, ending the escape with a sweet cutscene between the two before they return home.

Back at the house, Lucia walks through as Jason explains it’s still a work-in-progress. She’ll react to the work you did, potentially earning you some extra relationship points between the two. The mission ends the next morning with Lucia leaving for her work detail and Jason receiving a call from Donnie that leads to the next mission, Clean up After Donnie .

With Coming Home complete, you’ll receive the following general mission:

Earn Money – Bring in some money by any means necessary while Lucia deals with her community service.

If you need help thinking of other creative ways to make money, visit our Best Ways to Make Money Early guide . You’ll also have the mission from Donnie to find his package. Completing it progresses the main story .

Have fun with whatever you choose, and if you need additional help making your way around Key Lento and the southern part of Leonida, see these other guides next:

Up Next: Clean Up After Donnie Walkthrough

articles.title: The Best Black Friday Deals Worth Browsing on Thanksgiving Day
articles.body:
Black Friday 2026 is finally here. Although plenty of deals have gone live since the beginning of November, major retailers tend to save their absolute best sales for the core Black Friday time period starting Thanksgiving Day, running through Black Friday and the weekend, and ending on Cyber Monday. If you think you've seen the best that Amazon, Walmart, Target, Best Buy, and other stores have to offer, then think again. Expect to see even deeper discounts on video games, 4K Blu-ray movies, consoles, electronics, Apple devices, and much more over the next few days.

This list will be updated throughout the entire Black Friday sale event, so check back for new deals.

The Best (and Only) Black Friday Gaming Console Deal

Nintendo Switch 2 Mario Kart World Console Bundle

Save $50 off the official Black Friday Nintendo Switch 2 console bundle, which includes a copy of Mario Kart World and 3 months of Nintendo Switch Online membership. At this point, upgrading from the Switch to the Switch 2 is a no-brainer. Several Switch 2 exclusives have been released including Mario Kart World , Donkey Kong Bananza , Pokemon Pokopia , Kirby Air Riders , Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave , and more. Zelda: Ocarina of Time scored a 9/10 from IGN's Logan Plant .

Black Friday is the best time of year to expand your streaming library. Premier streaming services like Disney + (and Hulu), HBO Max, Paramount Plus, and Crunchyroll have dropped subscription fees to the lowest prices of the year . Some of these deals only come around during Black Friday, so if you miss them, you'll have to wait until the tail end of 2027. If you're ready to catch up on the Marvel Avengers movies before Avengers: Doomsday releases, or check out the fantastic Avatar: Seven Havens animated TV series, or finally see why the Solo Leveling anime is so popular, the time is now.

Apple MacBook Neo 13" A18 Pro (8GB/256GB)

articles.title: Avengers: Doomsday Teaser Shows Magneto Trying to Rip Doom's Mask Off, Leaves Us With More Questions Than Answers
articles.summary: Avengers: Doomsday has a new TV spot, shown in the U.S. overnight, that reveals key new scenes involving Magneto, Doom, Steve Rogers, and Thor.
articles.body:
Avengers: Doomsday has a new TV spot, shown in the U.S. overnight, that reveals key new scenes involving Magneto, Doom, Steve Rogers, and Thor.

The highlight of the TV spot, below, is Magneto desperately trying to use his mutant power to rip Doom’s mask off. "He is pain,” Magneto says. “He is extinction.” “I am Doom," Doom adds.

Unfortunately for our heroes, Doom is so powerful that he’s able to force it back on before his — presumably Robert Downey Jr.’s — face is revealed.

New teaser for ‘AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY’. In theaters December 18. — Avengers Updates (@AvengersUpdated) November 26, 2026

New teaser for ‘AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY’. In theaters December 18.

But is it actually Robert Downey Jr.’s face underneath the mask? There are all sorts of theories doing the rounds that suggest Marvel may be misdirecting fans about Doom’s true identity in Doomsday. We get a decent look at Doom’s green eyes before he uses his overwhelming power to conceal his face once again. Some are convinced it’s Oppenheimer star Cillian Murphy under the mask. That would be quite the shock given everything we know and have seen about the movie so far.

Earlier this month, Marvel Studios boss Kevin Feige confirmed that Doctor Doom is not a variant of Tony Stark in Doomsday . “Is Steve Rogers a Johnny Storm variant?" asked Feige. "People wondered, ‘Is Doom just a variant of another character? Is this just a shortcut to bringing back another character?’ The answer is no. He’s Victor Von Doom.” Is Feige misdirecting fans here?

Why would Magneto try to rip Doom’s mask off in the first place, rather than, say, immediately crush it? Perhaps the plan here is to remove the mask so that Professor X can get in his head? Either way, it doesn’t work.

Avengers: Doomsday Poster Montage Gallery

We also have a new look at Steve Rogers and Thor calmly walking up to Doom in his lair in Latveria. Are they trying to reason with Doom? Do they mean to confront him about his true motivation after some dramatic discovery? Steve Rogers looks pretty mad in this brief glimpse at the scene. Perhaps he feels betrayed?

And finally, we get the shot of Thor trying to hit Doom with Stormbreaker, only for Doom to block the hit with his finger.

Certainly, the more Marvel shows this movie, the more powerful Doom looks. Thanos was a powerful antagonist for sure, but he wasn’t this powerful. I expect the Avengers, X-Men, and The Fantastic Four are in for a rough ride.

Time for some speculation! Lots of people are suggesting there’s something off about Steve Rogers in what we’ve seen of him so far in this movie, to the point where they’re wondering if it’s actually Loki casting some illusion over everyone. We know Loki goes to see Steve and Peggy in what we now believe is The Fantastic Four’s universe to offer his help. Is this the help he was talking about?

We also see Doom’s three Latverian Witches in the new TV spot. While their identities remain a secret for now, fans believe they could be Sylvie, Clea, and Wanda. Are the masks they wear part of Doom’s magic mind control?

Avengers: Doomsday hits theaters December 18.

Wesley is IGN's Managing Editor. Find him on Twitter at @wyp100. You can reach Wesley at wesley_yinpoole@ign.com or confidentially at wyp100@proton.me.

articles.title: Save $100 Off the Apple MacBook Neo Laptop for Black Friday, Drops Back Down to Pre-Price Hike MSRP
articles.body:
If you're looking for a value-priced Apple laptop for basic everyday tasks like browsing, media streaming, word processing, and the like, then the recently released MacBook Neo is right up your alley. For Black Friday , you can get it for $599.99 with free shipping. This was the original launch price of the MacBook Neo before the $100 price hike back in June. I've never seen it drop this low since then and I don't expect it to drop this low again anytime soon.

Save $100 Off the 2026 Apple MacBook Neo

Apple MacBook Neo 13" A18 Pro (8GB/256GB)

The MacBook Neo was released on March 11, 2026. This is the only MacBook that's equipped with the A18 Pro chip, the same processor found in the iPhone 16. Note that it still uses the macOS operating system, not iOS found on Apple's mobile devices. It's not as powerful as the M5 chip found in the MacBook Air , but as a result the Neo is nearly half the price. It's certainly capable enough to handle all of your daily tasks and it still supports AI and Apple Intelligence features. After all, no one's getting a MacBook for gaming anyway.

The MacBook Neo features a 13" 2408x1506 (219ppi) Liquid Retina display, Apple A18 Pro chip with 6-core CPU, 5-core GPU, and 16-core NPU, 8GB of unified RAM, and a 256GB SSD. It measures about 0.5" thin and weighs in at 2.7 pounds. The chassis is 90% aluminum. Connectivity options include two USB-C ports, headphone jack, Wi-Fi 6E, and bluetooth.

IGN's Jackie Thomas gave the MacBook Neo a glowing 9/10 review , stating that it is "without a doubt, the best budget laptop you can buy today." It's basically an iPhone in a laptop form factor, and really there's nothing wrong with that.

articles.title: 1010 Mural Locations - GTA 6 Guide - IGN
articles.summary: Dotted around Vice City in GTA 6 are puzzling artworks known as 1010 Murals. There are five of these collectibles to find, and they're tricky to piece
articles.body:
Dotted around Vice City in GTA 6 are puzzling artworks known as 1010 Murals . There are five of these collectibles to find, and they're tricky to piece together, since you need to find both the mural and the correct location to stand to complete it. Note that you need to trigger this treasure hunt first by going on the SnapMatic app on your phone and browsing until you see a post about the artist, 1010.

There are five 1010 Murals to collect, all of which are located in Vice City:

Location: Stand on top of the mark on the roof of the Parlor Apartments on the corner of Northbrook Dr and Santiago Ave and take a picture down into the top of the colorful rainbow building across the street in Rockridge. You can reach this area via an elevator in the lobby.

Location: Stand on the marker on the corner of the roof of the New Quay Plaza building on SE 1st Ave and take a picture of the colorful rooftop below in Downtown. Reach this area by riding the elevator from the lobby to the rooftop.

Location: Stand next to the sign on top of the radio tower on the roof of the Piker Financial Center on SE 2nd Ave and take a photo of the colorful roof below. You can reach this location by taking the elevator to the rooftop and then climbing the tower.

Location: Stand on the mark on the sidewalk near the small parking lot alongside Barlow St and take a photo of the mural built up the southeast corner of the public parking garage in northwestern Ocean Beach.

Location: Stand on the mark on the sidewalk along NE 2nd Ave and take a photo of the mural on the train station while the painted train arrives at the station in central Crosstown. Note that you need the matching painted train to be stopped at the station to complete the mural, so wait for it to arrive.

1010 Murals Reward - Where to Find the 1010 Cheetah

Once you've completed all five 1010 Murals, you'll be sent a clue to find your prize: a custom '95 Grotti Cheetah sportscar. Go to the locked Southside Storage garage (it won't be marked on your map currently) next to the Slator Towing Inc Illegal Operation east of the airport. Approach the garage door to find a keypad requiring a code.

The garage code is 1010 , based on the artist's name.

Enter the code to open the door, unlocking the Southside Garage which contains the 1010 edition '95 Grotti Cheetah for free.

articles.title: Another Modder Uses AI to Make a Multiplayer Mode for The Last of Us Part 2 — Will Sony Shut This One Down, Too?
articles.summary: Another modder has used AI to make a multiplayer mode for The Last of Us Part 2, insisting there isn't much Sony can do about it "even if they do shut me down."
articles.body:
Another modder has used AI to make a multiplayer mode for The Last of Us Part 2 , insisting there isn't much Sony can do about it "even if they do shut me down."

The Last of Us had a brilliant multiplayer mode, with tense gunfights powered by weapon sway, smart cover, and nail-biting in-round crafting that forced you to dig around in your backpack as bullets whizzed over your bonce.

That’s why so many people were excited when Naughty Dog announced a Factions multiplayer game in the works based on The Last of Us Part 2 . Naughty Dog, however, eventually realized that making a live-service game would change the studio forever, and cancelled the project to focus instead on its upcoming sci-fi game, Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet .

The Last of Us Part 2 made some brilliant tweaks to the combat, allowing for better mobility and deeper stealth. The feel of the weapons, the crunch of the impacts, the audiovisual spectacle of it all was just something else, but we can only experience it in single-player, officially.

It’s no wonder people want to make Factions happen, even without Sony’s approval. And in September, a promising mod made some big strides towards getting multiplayer working in The Last of Us Part 2. As soon as it started to get traction, however, the mod was sent a cease and desist letter from Sony . “Hey everyone, as you all know, the TLOU 2 Multiplayer mod that has been in development since January was supposed to [be released] this month,” wrote creator 'Speclizer' at the time.

“Unfortunately I recently received a letter on behalf of Sony Interactive Entertainment requesting for the mod not to be released. Extremely sad that this never got to see the light of day but I hope you’ll continue to follow me onto the next project, this time something of my own.”

Now there’s a new mod hoping to avoid the eye of Sauron, and it’s already out. The mod is called Twelve Weeks and was built specifically for The Last of Us Part 2 Remastered on PC, using, its creator has admitted, generative AI. Modder 'Kellie' admitted to using Claude code for most of the game's development, and AI was even used to write the lore dumps you can find in the game. The art was, however, made using Blender .

The Last of Us returns with a new online multiplayer mode called TWELVE WEEKS created for The Last of Us Part 2 Remastered on PC. This free mod is a work in progress allowing players to experience a new version of the beloved Factions multiplayer with tactical survival gameplay — 𝗩𝗢𝗬𝗔𝗚𝗘𝗥𝗦 𝗥𝗘𝗩𝗘𝗡𝗚𝗘 (@VoyagersRevenge) November 24, 2026

The Last of Us returns with a new online multiplayer mode called TWELVE WEEKS created for The Last of Us Part 2 Remastered on PC. This free mod is a work in progress allowing players to experience a new version of the beloved Factions multiplayer with tactical survival gameplay

It features reworked levels — Supply Raid and Interrogation for now — with team-based 4v4 combat, new weapons, and character customization. Players can use gadgets like molotovs and smoke bombs, while fighting against other players as the WLF and Seraphites. The mod even adds brutal execution moves. You can grab Twelve Weeks on Nexus Mods .

However, the mod probably won't last long. The modders have attempted to cover their backs with a repository disclaimer that said: "Twelve Weeks is an unofficial fan project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Sony Interactive Entertainment or Naughty Dog. The Last of Us is a trademark of its owners. You need your own legitimately purchased copy of the game (Steam). This repository contains no game files and no assets taken from the game."

Will Sony take action? In a reply to someone on YouTube , Kellie said the previous Factions mod got hit by Sony because it was paywalled. "Mine is released already for free and in open source," they said. "Since people have the source code to the full mod already, there ain't much they can do even if they do shut me down."

While The Last of Us Online was canceled, there are hints that Naughty Dog may be ready to return to the series for The Last of Us 3 . And then there is HBO's The Last of Us TV series , which is currently shooting its third (and likely last) season.

Kirk McKeand is a Contributor on IGN News. Find him on Twitter @MckKirk

articles.title: What Is Muse? How To Save On Brain-Sensing Wearables This Black Friday
articles.summary: Save 25% on EEG brain-sensing sleep and meditation headbands this Black Friday with code BFCM25, cutting nearly £100 off lab-grade sleep stage trackers.
articles.body:
As we close in on the holidays, things can feel more than a little stressful. Whether it’s buying presents for loved ones, planning where you’ll be spending the time, or just reflecting on a tough year (we’re with you), it can all have an adverse effect on your sleep.

Thankfully, it’s never been easier to track your sleep and understand what’s causing you to miss out on those sweet dreams - and Muse offers something a little different. Eschewing traditional wearable tech for brain-sensing products, Muse reads your brainwaves and oxygenation trends in real time.

Better yet, you can save for Black Friday . And hey, maybe it’ll help you buy for a loved one, too. The secret here is using voucher code BFCM25, netting you 25% off two of its popular models.

Muse are specialists in brain activity tracking, and offers headbands packed with sensors to understand what’s going on in your gray matter.

It includes EEG and fNIRS scanners to check your brain activity in real time, bringing sleep study-level knowledge to your home - far beyond what you can expect from a wearable on your wrist or a smart ring.

Aside from the headband, Muse offers its own Premium Subscription. This includes guided meditations for focus, stress management, and sleep, and advanced data tracking while also allowing syncing with third-party apps.

Save On Muse’s Brain Health, Sleep, and Recovery Trackers This Black Friday

In my line of work as a fitness tech reviewer, I’ve gone hands-on with a ton of wearables, and while EDA scans can assess how your body is reacting to stress, Muse’s S Athena and Muse 2 go beyond that.

The Muse S Athena is designed to help users understand their sleep, and how it affects their recovery on a day-to-day basis. Rather than a smart ring or watch-like tracker that estimates sleep from heart rate and movement cues, the Muse S Athena gets it directly from the source - your brain.

In fact, it has an accuracy rating for sleep stage tracking of 88-96% when compared against traditional polysomnography techniques, which is what’s used in sleep labs.

Because it knows what sleep stage you're in, the Muse S Athena can help you drift off with Sleep Assist, while Deep Sleep Boost plays soft sounds timed to your brain's deep sleep waves.

For Black Friday, you can save almost £100, too - now £281.43, instead of the RRP of £375.25.

If you’re looking for an alternative, you can also save 25% on the Muse 2. This is ideal for anyone already wearing a fitness tracker, and it leans into using meditation to guide your brain activity back to where it needs to be.

It reads your brain activity with EEG and turns it into sound in real time: calm weather and birdsong when you’re settled, rising wind when your attention drifts. That cue helps you catch the moment you’ve wandered and bring your focus back, the core skill of meditation, with live feedback.

Over time, that practice sharpens your focus and helps you manage stress.

Muse is backed by 200+ third-party-led studies, including research at Mayo Clinic, MIT and Harvard. Muse 2 also works with Brain Age, which shows how old your brain appears compared to your actual age, with your first reading free after a week of data. It’s down to £148.12, down from £197.49.

Lloyd Coombes is an experienced freelancer in tech, gaming and fitness seen at Polygon, Eurogamer, Macworld, TechRadar and many more. He's a big fan of Magic: The Gathering and other collectible card games, much to his wife's dismay.

articles.body:
The November 26, 2026 Patch for Marvel Rivals has arrived, bringing with it a new map , new in-store content, the Ghostworks Arcade, and various adjustments and fixes.

This page acts as a comprehensive breakdown of the November 26 Patch for Marvel Rivals, including a link to the full Patch Notes.

The new Incursion Point map allows for an an all-out, Chronoverse-shaking 18 vs. 18 Chrono Annihilation showdown, where Doom 2099 has launched an invasion with his full armada as the Anti-Matter Cannon cannot yet fire again.

The Galactic Center, the cosmic anniversary hub, is opening in full, with a wide variety of rewards to claim as you partake in festivities and various game modes.

The Ghostworks Arcade has opened in Times Square Galactic Center, where you'll find 6 arcade mini-games . Complete a series of mini-game challenges to score themed Sprays and exclusive Titles, and collect Arcade Stamps along the way to claim an extra 400 Units and the Arcade Ace Title.

Running from November 26 to January 21st , complete this costume design mini-game to earn exchange currencies based on the quality of your Blueprints, then trade them in at the Exchange Store to snag the dazzling Legendary Deadpool - Moment Stealer costume and more for free.

Running from November 26, 2026 to December 24, 2027 , go to the red mailbox in Times Square and leave behind your own stories, thoughts and narratives. You can even send a time-capsule letter across the Timestream to your future self which'll unlock this time next year!

A new Black Friday tab has been added to the in-game store, allowing you to grab large discounts on various bundles and cosmetics. This will run from November 26 to December 1 .

November 26 - December 25 Lady Loki - Envious Emerald Bundle Scarlet Witch - Virtual Insanity Bundle Moon Knight - Moonjack Hacker Bundle

November 26 Lady Loki - Envious Emerald Chroma Crimson Cunning/Indigo Illusion and Ultimate Ability VFX Deadpool - Moment Stealer Chroma Gilded Gunner/Blue Blades and Ultimate Ability VFX Cloak & Dagger - Gilded Agate Chroma Garnet Gleam/Malachite Mist and Ultimate Ability VFX

articles.title: New Model Apple iPad Tablets Are on Sale for Black Friday, Including the iPad Mini Released This Month
articles.summary: Mostly erases the price hikes from earlier in 2026.
articles.body:
Apple raised prices on its iPads earlier in June of 2026, but Black Friday is an opportunity to mostly wipe out these price increases. Starting Thanksgiving day, Amazon has dropped prices across the board on the latest generation iPads, from the diminutive Mini to the laptop replacing iPad Pro. Several of these prices are lower than the deals from earlier this week, so even if you think you're up to date on the Black Friday pricing, check again.

November 2026 release; major upgrade over its predecessor

Normally, most iPad updates are incremental CPU upgrades. Not with this update.The Apple iPad Mini is the newest iPad, released earlier this month on November 6. It's a huge upgrade over its predecessor, featuring an gorgeous 8.5" 2316x1512 (326ppi) OLED display, Apple A20 Pro chip with 12GB of RAM, and 128GB of internal storage. This is also the first ever iPad with IP67 dust and water resistance. It's even thinner and lighter than its predecessor, weighing in at a mere 9 ounces. Other new features include Wi-Fi 7, support for Apple Intelligence and Siri AI, and Apple Pencil, Smart Folio compatibility.

The standard iPad is still the the iPad we'd recommend for most people . The current generation model was released back in March of 2025 and features an 11" 2360x1640 (264ppi) Liquid Retina display, A16 chip, and 128GB of internal storage. The combination of a great display, snappy performance, and nearly all the benefits of iOS for under $400 is hard to beat.

The iPad Air was released earlier this year in May. The biggest upgrade is the Apple M4 chip, which is about 20%-30% faster than the M3 chip found on the previous generation model. The iPad Air also supports Apple Intelligence. Apple bumped the iPad Air's memory by 50%, from 8GB to 12GB of RAM. That's enough to run multiple resource-heavy apps, mult-task, and take advantange of processor-intenstive AI features better than before. In addition to increased memory, the iPad also has a brand new N1 wireless chip. For the first time, the iPad Air supports Wi-Fi 7, which offers wireless faster-than-gigabit networking speeds, and Bluetooth 6.

Apple iPad Pro Starting at $1,049 (was $1,200)

The 2025 iPad Pro is currently best tablet on the market, iOS or otherwise, thanks to its M5 processor which is both more powerful and power efficient than its predecessor. It also offers 50% more RAM, faster storage speed, Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6 standards, and faster charging. This current generation model features a gorgeous tandem OLED panel. Tandem OLED is better than traditional OLED in two ways: 1) it's far brighter, and 2) it's less prone to burn-in.

Eric Song is the IGN commerce manager in charge of finding the best gaming and tech deals every day. When Eric isn't hunting for deals for other people at work, he's hunting for deals for himself during his free time.

articles.title: South Park Season 29 Has Been Very Flawed, but 'City Endings' Offers a Mostly Satisfying Finale
articles.summary: South Park caps off a very uneven Season 29 with the messy but still very enjoyable finale episode "City Endings." Read our full review.
articles.body:
Full spoilers ahead for South Park Season 29, Episode 6!

There hasn't been a real, concerted effort to build an overarching narrative in South Park Season 29. Sure, certain plot threads have carried forward, like the arrival of Little Randy and Kenny's latest brush with death, but by and large this season has just drifted from one topic to the next. But that doesn't stop Trey Parker, Matt Stone, and the rest from trying to tie everything together in the finale. It's a pretty messy conclusion - a City Ending, even - but a mostly entertaining one.

As was teased throughout this season, everything culminates with November's big event. Not the US midterms, but the long-awaited arrival of GTA 6. Literally everyone in town is busy playing Rockstar's masterpiece, which makes things kind of awkward when it turns out the majority of South America's power grid is being hijacked by billionaire weenies and their data centers.

I definitely would have preferred a more focused and organic approach to weaving together this season's various storylines, but I do appreciate the effort to tie it all together here at the end. "City Endings" does a pretty good job of lampooning all the AI-related headlines that have swirled as of late, from the Jensen Huang/AMD situation to the recent spate of technical meltdowns. It's especially fitting that we see the characters collectively lose their minds over imagined Chinese cyberattacks rather than look inward and realize the problem is coming from inside the house.

It doesn't hurt that the show swings back around to focus on Mr. Kim and the latest evolution of City Wok, which has now been transformed from a clearing house for crappy e-bikes to a sordid massage parlor. It's pretty amusing to watch Kim frantically run around trying to "please" his growing lineup of customers while his disinterested wife goofs off in the back. I complain a lot about the series regurgitating the same jokes over and over, but here I think there's a nice sense of escalation over the course of the episode. I'll also be curious to see if the ending holds and whether Kim returns from his little sojourn in space.

"City Endings" also makes solid use of Butters and his family, as we see how thoroughly corrupted Butters has become thanks to his proximity to power and wealth. We get a fun little parody of The Twilight Zone episode "It's a Good Life," at least until Butters is exposed. That's a great way of paying off on the whole antivax subplot from earlier in the season. There's even a hilariously sad little bit involving Peter and his hapless attempt to insert himself into the Kenny-shaped hole in the group.

Again, this episode is nothing if not chaotic in its attempts to weave all of Season 29's ongoing threads together. There are certain things I would have liked to see more payoff for, including the Little Randy of it all (is this just the ongoing status quo for that character now?). I also felt the Kenny subplot deserved a little more focus than it receives here. But despite those concerns, "City Endings" works as a largely satisfying conclusion to a very uneven season of South Park. And now we don't have to refer to the show as "South America" any longer.

articles.title: Watching TV in GTA 6 Is More Depressing Than Fun, Except for One Show
articles.summary: GTA 6's TV content is impressive on a technical level, but apart from one standout show, it's not all that fun to actually watch.
articles.body:
It seems there’s almost nothing you can’t do in Grand Theft Auto VI, other than solicit prostitutes . Far more than just being a murder and crime spree simulator, the game allows you to kick back and do everything from play basketball to remodel your house to work out at the gym. And yes, that long list of side activities includes watching television.

GTA 6 includes multiple channels of original programming , featuring everything from breaking Vice City news reports to Adult Swim-style animated sitcoms to cheesy telenovelas. As with so much about the new game, the level of detail Rockstar undertook here is impressive. But despite all that, I found that actually sitting down to watch TV in-game wasn’t quite the entertaining experience I was hoping for. If anything, it was a little depressing.

To recap, there are three live TV channels in GTA 6 - the Fox News-spoofing Weazel News, the Telemundo parody Megamundo, and the travel-focused Visit Leonida. For the purposes of this piece, I’m mostly focusing on the former channel. Megamundo is a fun sendup of traditional Spanish-language soap operas, but not having any real attachment to that genre, it’s a joke that only has so much mileage for me. And Visit Leonida is definitely the most limited of the three channels.

With Weazel News, you have a smorgasbord of faux-TV content, all of which focuses on lampooning the right-wing news sector, reality TV, and general American culture. This stream cycles through various breaking news reports, a mockumentary-style series called “The Tyrone Show,” and several different animated sitcoms. And commercials. Dozens and dozens of satirical commercials for all sorts of in-universe products and services.

Initially, you can’t help but sit back and admire the sheer effort that went into making all this content. The TV channels are a very minor feature in the game, and I’m sure many people won’t even really pay attention to them amid all the other countless side activities. The simple fact that you can spend literal hours just sitting in front of a fake TV and not really see any repeat content is impressive.

But once the initial novelty wears off, watching TV isn’t what I’d describe as one of the more rewarding pastimes in GTA 6. Weazel News actually left me feeling a bit stressed out and unhappy after a while. It was hard to put my finger on it at first, but I think what it comes down to is that the political and social satire hits a little too close to home.

For a Scottish-based studio, Rockstar North is generally pretty adept at satirizing American culture with these games - whether it’s remixing the best elements of classic crime films or lampooning the average American’s love of fast food, beer, and guns. You get a heaping helping of all of that with Weazel TV, particularly in the many faux-commercials where colorful characters hawk various brands of alcohol or campaign for a missile launcher in every home or what have you.

The problem is that this material no longer feels as outlandish as it once might have. The sad truth is that real life in the US moved beyond parody at some point in the last 10-15 years. It’s something that a lot of sources of satire have dealt with lately, from South Park to The Onion. How do you top reality when reality has become so unhinged and unbelievable?

GTA’s TV content is in the same boat. A lot of it doesn’t feel particularly far removed from reality anymore. There really are people unironically spouting the same kind of jingoistic nonsense you see in these fake commercials. Between extreme right-wing news channels and the digital hellscape that is social media, there’s a real cultural brain rot that’s taken hold. Watching Weazel TV is more an uncomfortable reminder of where we are as a society than a truly unbelievable parody.

That’s part of it, anyway. The other issue is that some of the Weazel TV humor feels a bit unnecessarily mean-spirited, particularly anything involving the news broadcasts and Tyrone’s sexually charged misadventures. Rockstar really goes all-in on the “Florida Man” humor, mirroring the sorts of kooky regional headlines and weird characters we’ve all read about online. Through the fictionalized state of Leonida, it paints the real Florida as this unending wasteland of deranged hillbillies and unrepentant criminals. And, yes, Florida has more than its fair share of odd residents, but many perfectly lovely people live there also.

I always look to King of the Hill as the gold standard when it comes to satirizing a specific American subculture. That animated sitcom is a clear parody of small-town Texan life, but it never settles for leaning on stereotypes or punching down on its colorful cast of characters. They’re all surprisingly nuanced and fully realized for what might seem at first like a bunch of goofy, beer-chugging rednecks.

GTA’s main cast of characters may get a similarly nuanced treatment, by and large, but the same can’t really be said for the goofballs who appear on Weazel News. Unlike King of the Hill, this TV content does gleefully punch down, and that means it doesn’t fully sit right.

That all being said, there is one good reason to keep Jason’s butt planted on the couch and stay tuned to Weazel News. The channel’s animated sitcoms generally do a better job than the other shows when it comes to providing an amusing dose of escapism. It’s easy to picture any one of these shows having a run on Adult Swim in between reruns of Rick and Morty, whether it’s the stoner humor-focused Macca & Friends or the aggressively copaganda-minded “children’s program” Barnyard Blue.

But the real success story in this area is definitely Right Wing. Right Wing is basically a superhero cartoon about a dimwitted defender of Truth, Justice, and the American Way, or the stereotypical ultraconservative vision of it, anyway. Each episode pits the hero and his handler (a very George W. Bush-coded President) against a different conservative boogeyman villain like the border wall-busting Immigrantasma or the psychically-empowered Educated Woman. Ultimately, Right Wing usually doesn’t save the day so much as he makes a giant ass of himself and exposes the hypocrisy of the anti-left, anti-feminist, anti-LGBTQ+ agenda. All in a day’s work.

Of all the hours of TV content programmed into GTA 6, the Right Wing cartoons are easily my favorite. They’re both hilarious and insightful. The satire works in a way the more direct gags in the rest of the Weazel News content don’t always land. Again, this legitimately feels like something that could run on Adult Swim and find a sizable following in the process.

Only time will tell what sort of additional content Rockstar will add to GTA 6 in the months and years to come. I’m sure the studio is currently heads-down on getting the next version of GTA Online ready for what’s sure to be a historic launch. But I sincerely hope the developer looks at expanding the currently available TV content. There are lessons to be learned in terms of what works and doesn’t work on Weazel News. The main lesson: focus less on trying to satirize the unsatirizable aspects of American culture and focus more on these wonderful little adult cartoons. Season 2 of Right Wing would be much appreciated.

Jesse is a mild-mannered staff writer for IGN. Allow him to lend a machete to your intellectual thicket by following @jschedeen on BlueSky .
